data.name: Fuzzball Incorporated
data.detailed_description:
You just got a new job at Fuzzball Incorporated's secret lab, and now have to spend your nights keeping a bunch of monstrous test creatures from escaping out into the world and/or just killing you... no pressure. Watch over the situation with the security cameras, protect the exits with your control panel, and don't forget to protect yourself should the need arise.

You are a security guard, stationed in a surveillance/control room overlooking the forest area that the lab is built under, and you have access to a number of useful tools, that will hopefully allow you to make it through this horrific job. Your room has a monitor in it that allows you to view the security cameras placed in the woods and keep an eye on the escaped creatures as they come up to the surface. You also have a control panel that allows you to move an automated defense system into the path of the test creatures before they leave the area, unfortunately it can't be in multiple places at once and it's repellent chemical spray needs to be regularly refilled. You also might want to watch your back, as a creature may try to climb up to your room, thankfully you have your own portable can of that spray. There might be more things to worry about as time goes on, but you can probably handle it. Oh, also, remember not to tell anyone about any of this. Fuzzball Incorporated's got to maintain it's cuddly reputation after all.

Note: this game is still in a very early stage of development, so while the gameplay and story are probably pretty close to the final version, most if not all of the graphics are just placeholders.

data.short_description: In this surveillance horror game, a bunch of evil creatures are trying to escape from a secret lab and it's your job to stop them. Watch the cameras to track them, use your control panel to block them, and use your repellent spray can on anything that reaches your room. Welcome to Fuzzball Inc.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Modern Graphics Card (Vulkan Support Required)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Please, let us know what worked for you.
